_note: A duplicate object key is dropped only when its mapped start is an element attribute's own node, the way svelte-check asks the Svelte AST: the handle-and-forward `on:` idiom on elements, <svelte:window> and <svelte:element> (inside blocks too) and a spread beside a named attribute stay silent, while a duplicate key inside a `{...}` expression, in markup or in an attribute value, is reported. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55 (which additionally reports a TS2322 on the title attribute through the real element typings, absent here without a svelte install).
